proposals.title: Advisory Vote on a Shareholder Proposal Requesting to Change the Thresholds to Call Special Shareholder Meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend bylaws so holders of 15% of outstanding common stock can call a special shareholder meeting, and remove the one-year holding period.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends voting AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Advisory Vote on a Shareholder Proposal Requesting the Board Issue a Report on Sugar and Public Health
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report, with independent scientists, on sugar product sales to consumers, especially children, and related risks to finances and reputation, by November 1, 2020.
proposals.evidence: Our Board recommends voting AGAINST the advisory proposal requesting that the Board issue a report on sugar and public health.
